title: Localization
summary: In-place L1 module: data-owned string table (content/loc/strings.json) compiled to typed C accessors, CLDR plurals, language-owned digit grouping, fallback chain active -> fallback -> key, formatted strings allocated from the engine's per-frame scratch arena. Knows nothing about any game's key vocabulary.
dependencies: Neotolis nt_core (NT_ASSERT: the contracts in loc.h are asserts)
a game-owned content/loc/strings.json; loc.py validates it against schema/strings.schema.json (shape) and then applies the checks a grammar cannot express
a game C runtime compiling the generated loc_strings.gen.{h,c}

registers.note: Describes the wiring a consuming game performs in its own CMakeLists/GameCodegen.cmake -- localization is an in-place module (precedent features/progression-core), not an install-script target. This section documents the provisioning, it does not perform it. The consuming game additionally owns tests/test_loc.c (the runtime contract suite) and src/ui/loc_widgets.c; only the two targets listed here are built purely from module sources.
